title: Schema _merge must accept AnyType on the right-hand side so infer_signature is order-independent
answers: infer_signature fails when a None value appears after a concrete value in a list of dicts
Expected all values in the list to be of the same type error with None in a list of messages
logged model loses input validation because the signature fell back to AnyType for chat history with content None
merge concrete type with AnyType depends on element order in schema inference
body:
Symptom: infer_signature on a list of records (e.g. OpenAI-style chat history) either raises "Expected all values in the list to be of the same type" or silently falls back to a generic AnyType schema with no input validation, when a field is None in a later element but not in the first.
Root cause: mlflow/types/schema.py:Property._merge, Array._merge and Map._merge only merged when the other side had an identical DataType, so a concrete-vs-AnyType merge succeeded only when AnyType was on the left (AnyType._merge already accepted any concrete type).
Fix pattern: In each of those _merge methods, treat an AnyType on the other side as compatible with a concrete self dtype (e.g. `self.dtype == other.dtype or isinstance(other.dtype, AnyType)`) and return the concrete self type. Keep required as the conjunction of both sides.
Constraints: Applies only when self holds a concrete DataType. Incompatible concrete types (long vs string) must still raise MlflowException. Covered by tests/types/test_schema.py:test_merge_with_anytype_is_order_independent and test_infer_schema_with_anytype.
applies: Schema type merging in mlflow/types/schema.py used by infer_signature and ColSpec/Object/Array/Map inference.
says: Inferring model signature fails with type mismatch when missing values appear later in message history.
Logged chat model loses input validation because sample records have empty fields in subsequent turns.
Model schema detection should work consistently regardless of where null values appear in sample records.
Saving conversational models crashes when later entries in chat history contain null message content.
search: Schema merging in mlflow/types/schema.py must accept AnyType on the right-hand side so that infer_signature is order-independent. When merging schemas in Property._merge, Array._merge, and Map._merge, treat a right-hand AnyType as compatible with a concrete self.dtype and return the concrete type while keeping required as the conjunction of both sides. This rule applies when self holds a concrete DataType, whereas incompatible concrete types must still raise an MlflowException.
